protocol: F5 · hierarchical modular reservoir × memory capacity
methodology: Naud (2011) delayed-input memory capacity; Nat Commun 2026-07 hierarchical modular reservoirs
interpretation: Isolation-degree (drop_magnitude) vs reservoir memory capacity on Naud delayed-input task. A POSITIVE r suggests isolation supports memory (matches Nat Commun 2026-07 hierarchical-modular result); a NEGATIVE r suggests a tension between isolation and recurrent reuse. The project's unique contribution is to QUANTIFY the sign of this relationship across many topologies and give an analytic bound — not to build a bigger simulator.
